common.name: Common
common.description: Generic elements — such as processes, functions, services, and events — that are shared and reused across the Business, Application, and Technology domains rather than duplicated per domain.

motivation.name: Motivation
motivation.description: Elements used to model the motivations that guide the design or change of an enterprise architecture, including stakeholders, drivers, goals, and requirements.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.description: Elements used to model the strategic direction and choices of an enterprise, including capabilities, resources, and courses of action.

business.name: Business
business.description: Elements typically used to model the Business Architecture: products and services offered to customers, and the actors, roles, and interfaces that realize them.

application.name: Application
application.description: Elements typically used to model the Application Architecture: the structure, behavior, and interaction of software applications.

technology.name: Technology
technology.description: Elements typically used to model the Technology Architecture: the structure and behavior of technology infrastructure, spanning both IT and physical/operational technology.

implementation-migration.name: Implementation & Migration
implementation-migration.description: Elements that support the implementation and migration of architectures, including work packages, deliverables, and plateaus representing stable states over time.
